findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_deals" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List the creator's active brand deals, most recently updated first, with stage, offer value and what is waiting on the creator. Filter by stage, by deals that n…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_deal, search_inbox, get_inbox_thread, send_reply, review_brand_contract, check_sponsorship_disclosure · Private data: review_brand_contract · Public sink: get_deal, get_inbox_thread, send_reply, check_sponsorship_disclosure, plan_pitch_followups · Destructive: review_brand_contract.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_deal, search_inbox, get_inbox_thread, send_reply, review_brand_contract, check_sponsorship_disclosure · Private data: review_brand_contract · Public sink: get_deal, get_inbox_thread, send_reply, check_sponsorship_disclosure, plan_pitch_followups · Destructive: review_brand_contract

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
